sections.title: The clever goat

captions: Hello, and welcome to Atomic English, Stage 3. In this lesson: The clever goat.
Read a traditional-style tale and use the past simple of regular verbs.
Here are some new words. Village. A very small town in the country. Clever.
Good at thinking and finding answers. Hungry. Wanting to eat. Listen and say them.
village
clever
hungry.
And some more words. Cross. Go from one side to the other. Fool.
Trick someone so they believe something. Escape. Get away from danger.
Listen and say them. cross
fool
escape.
Time for a question. The video will stop.
Which word means: a very small town in the country?
Now some grammar: Past simple: regular verbs.
Add -ed to regular verbs to talk about the past. For example: walk becomes walked.
For example: jump becomes jumped.
Now listen, and read along. The goat and the hungry wolf.
Once upon a time, a little goat lived in a village by the hills.
One day she walked to a bridge. A hungry wolf waited under the bridge.
‘I want to eat you!’ he shouted. The clever goat smiled. ‘I am very small,’ she said.
‘My big sister is coming. She is fatter and tastier than me.’
The wolf waited and waited. The little goat crossed the bridge and escaped.
Her sister never came, because she was at home!
Another question. The video will stop. Where did the goat live?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like village, clever, hungry.
You practised past simple: regular verbs. And you read The goat and the hungry wolf.
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!

sections.title: What happened next?

options.fb: “then” means after that, at that time.

captions: Hello, and welcome to Atomic English, Stage 3. In this lesson: What happened next?
Use irregular past forms and order words to retell a story.
Here are some new words. First. Before everything else. Next. After that. Then.
After that, at that time. Listen and say them. first
next
then.
And some more words. Finally. At the end. Suddenly.
Very quickly and when you don't expect it. Afraid. Scared. Listen and say them. finally
suddenly
afraid.
Time for a question. The video will stop. Which word means: before everything else?
Now some grammar: Past simple: irregular verbs.
Some verbs change in a special way in the past. You have to learn them.
For example: go becomes went. For example: see becomes saw.
For example: eat becomes ate. For example: run becomes ran.
Now listen, and read along. The lost shoe.
First, Omar went to the beach with his family.
He took off his shoes and ran into the sea.
Next, he played in the waves for a long time. Then he came back, but one shoe was gone!
He looked everywhere. He felt afraid because they were new shoes.
Suddenly, a little dog ran up to him. It had something in its mouth. It was Omar's shoe!
Finally, Omar laughed and gave the dog a big hug.
Another question. The video will stop. Where did Omar go?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like first, next, then.
You practised past simple: irregular verbs. And you read The lost shoe.
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!
